{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
file_path = '/home/musel/Github/research_agent/data/sales.csv'
sales = pd.read_csv(file_path)

# Fix revenue: remove commas and convert to float
sales['revenue_clean'] = sales['revenue'].str.replace(',', '').astype(float)

# Check for QA orders (revenue == 999999.99)
qa_orders = sales[sales['revenue_clean'] == 999999.99]
print("QA order count:", len(qa_orders))

# Check for refunded orders
refunded = sales[sales['status'] == 'refunded']
print("Refunded order count:", len(refunded))

# Filter for completed orders only
completed = sales[sales['status'] == 'completed']

# Compute mean revenue for completed orders, excluding QA and refunded
mean_revenue = completed['revenue_clean'].mean()
print("Mean revenue of completed orders:", mean_revenue)"}
